To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the adoption of an electronic integrated care pathway in preoperative care can be attributed to the combination of a policy context promoting the rationalisation and standardisation of pre-assessment pathways and a pragmatic, domain agnostic, and iterative implementation strategy.

“The adoption of the preoperative electronic form into routine work practices is the result of a combination of factors including: a policy context, financial and organisational support, a sustained engagement with key stakeholders and a pragmatic technology solution”.

the successful implementation of the preoperative integrated care pathways was the result of a combination of factors: a policy context promoting the rationalisation and standardisation of surgical pre-operative pathways; financial and organisational support; the sustained engagement of stakeholders; the adoption of a pragmatic and generic technology solution and finally a consensual and contextually sensitive implementation process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of a pragmatic and flexible information technology solution to support the standardisation of surgical preoperative pathways in a health-board.
the implementation of a pragmatic technology solution for the operationalisation of standardised preoperative pathways.
the implementation and use of an integrated preassessment eForm within a health-board and its impact on the quality of preoperative care.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the successful implementation of the eForm was a result of the synergistic efforts of a number of complementary standardisation efforts.
the eForm was implemented in the health-board because of the synergies between the PCIP and the eHealth programme.
the adoption of the e-Form in the healthboard is due to the synergistic effect of the PCIP and eHealth programmes, and the engagement of the preoperative stakeholders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the implementation of an electronic integrated care pathway and a regional clinical portal for pre-assessment has resulted in a more efficient and patient-centred preoperative pathway.
the successful deployment of a standardised preoperative eForm was a result of the alignment of strategic and operational efforts.
the eForm has been successfully implemented in the context of an integrated care pathway for preoperative assessment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a successful implementation of a new technology solution requires the alignment of a number of complementary strategic efforts.
the successful adoption of an information technology solution for preoperative care is dependent on the alignment of multiple complementary strategic initiatives.
a combination of local and national strategic efforts is necessary to achieve a successful implementation of a preoperative integrated care pathways.
